title: openai-compat: support Responses API seed/determinism + metadata passthrough; streaming & tool-calling stability fixes
author: Maya Thompson
release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses compatibility: pass through seed and determinism flags, carry metadata to responses, improve streaming stability and tool/function calling edge cases; no public API breaking changes.
description: Motivation: Newer OpenAI Responses variants expose deterministic seeding and richer per-response metadata which Redwood's openai-compat layer did not consistently surface. This caused parity gaps for customers migrating test harnesses and reproducibility-oriented workloads. Additionally, we observed intermittent streaming stalls when tool/function-calling events interleaved with metadata events. This PR adds deterministic seeding passthrough, preserves user-provided metadata on Responses, and fixes streaming race conditions that affected tool/function calling. Summary of changes: 1) Wire seed and determinism flags from OpenAI-style Requests through to our runtime adapter and underlying model invocation; we expose these as optional parameters in the openai_compat layer and map to internal sampling controls. 2) Carry metadata fields present on incoming prompts/requests through to the Response objects so downstream analytics and audit logs can correlate events. Metadata is preserved as-is and surfaced under response.metadata for OpenAI-compat clients. 3) Stabilize streaming: ensure metadata and function_call frames do not trigger buffer flush races; add an ordered-event buffer and deterministic flush on EOE/close. 4) Tool/function calling: handle nested function selection events and avoid duplicate invocation signals when clients reconnect mid-stream. 5) Tests and docs: add integration tests covering seed determinism reproducibility, metadata propagation, streaming resume cases, and function-calling edge cases; update openai_compat docs and quickstart. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged if seed/determinism not provided. Rollout plan: feature gated behind openai_compat.v2 flag for 2 weeks, monitor perf and correctness dashboards, then enable for all hosted customers. See linked Linear items for regression windows and telemetry dashboards.
